## What improves?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or design change.

## Revision and affected interfaces

List the source revision, affected parts/programs and compatibility changes.

## Evidence

Describe measurements, checks, screenshots or tests. State clearly if the change is a concept and has not been built or tested.

## Documentation and files

- [ ] Relevant source and exports are included, where applicable.
- [ ] Instructions, BOM and website references reflect the change, where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials or supplier CAD are included.
- [ ] I understand that maintainers review the change before merging under the project licenses.
